focus.title: Focus
focus.description: Select or report the single Workflow v2 pilot application.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Audit the focused application, pages, security, usability, or pilot flow.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Report focused app stage, scores, coverage, blockers, and one next command.

page-map.title: Page Map
page-map.description: Inventory and pilot-classify focused application routes.

page.title: Page
page.description: Create or update a complete evidence-backed P0 page brief.

components.title: Components
components.description: Map pages to existing components, variants, and states.

usability.title: Usability
usability.description: Review usability, accessibility, RTL, and responsive behavior.

check.title: Check
check.description: Run deterministic focused checks and artifact validation.

design.title: Design
design.description: Produce GateFlow design contracts and audits.

api.title: API
api.description: Plan or review secure typed API resources and flows.

database.title: Database
database.description: Plan or audit safe tenant-aware database work.

security.title: Security
security.description: Run a read-only focused security review.

test.title: Test
test.description: Run focused test scopes with dated evidence.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Inspect or prepare focused GitHub and CI work with mutation hardlocks.

vercel.title: Vercel
vercel.description: Inspect focused Vercel readiness with mutation hardlocks.

observe.title: Observe
observe.description: Audit reliability, observability, and pilot metrics.

release.title: Release
release.description: Prepare a focused release and rollback handoff.

pilot.title: Pilot
pilot.description: Orchestrate the focused pilot or run its bounded loop profile through certification.

certify.title: Certify
certify.description: Certify a pilot-ready application from fresh evidence.

next-app.title: Next App
next-app.description: Recommend and confirm the next fixed-sequence pilot application.

idea.title: Idea
idea.description: Capture and refine GateFlow initiatives into IDEA_<slug>.md and backlog entries.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Capture raw planning notes under docs/plan/Draft/<slug>/ before formal /plan.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Build FOR_PLAN_PROMPT.md from draft to feed /plan.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Turn an IDEA_<slug>.md into a phased PLAN_<slug>.md plus PROMPT_<slug>_phase_<N>.md pro prompts.

dev.title: Dev
dev.description: Implement one phase or run a bounded approved plan/task loop with explicit delivery gates.

ship.title: Ship
ship.description: Execute all remaining phases of a plan sequentially via repeated /dev-style execution.

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: Run the GateFlow workspace guide — router plus coach; what should I do now?

man.title: Man
man.description: One Man — one command, seven domains (Code, Brand, SaaS, Marketing, Business, Content, Copywrite).

brainstorm.title: Brainstorm
brainstorm.description: Strategic brainstorming for roadmap, gaps, and release planning.

creative.title: Creative
creative.description: Creative direction for brand, content, and marketing assets.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.description: Deploy target app or workspace apps per deploy workflow.

clis-team.title: CLIs Team
clis-team.description: Run a predefined CLI team (seo, refactor, audit). Cursor is master; team outputs are proposals.

docs.title: Docs
docs.description: Automated documentation updates — changelog, version badge, PRD, feature log, README, release.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic versioning — bump package.json, create annotated git tags, generate versioned branch names.

organize.title: Organize
organize.description: Docs folder cleanup — scan structure, remove empty dirs and dead symlinks, rebuild docs/INDEX.md.

ralph.title: Ralph
ralph.description: Compatibility alias for the bounded /dev loop across all approved remaining phases.
